title: Extremely Dense Scottish American Haggis Casserole
description: A spicy, dense, and indulgent American dish featuring haggis, slow-cooked to perfection, and FODMAP-friendly. This casserole is a unique fusion of Scottish and American cuisine.

ingredients.name: garlic-infused oil
ingredients.notes: use garlic-infused oil to avoid FODMAPs

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pan, cook the ground beef over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until it is translucent.
Add the garlic-infused oil, scotch bonnet peppers, and cooked haggis to the pan, stirring well to combine.
In a separate pot, boil the potatoes until they are tender, then mash them with a fork.
In a large casserole dish, combine the cooked ground beef mixture, mashed potatoes, and gluten-free oats, stirring until well combined.
Top the casserole with the lactose-free cheddar cheese.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 2 hours.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 30 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
